description: What a theme's style sheet can reach. The web build draws exactly these classes (DT_CLASSES in web/src/desktop/theme.ts, a test keeps both equal); the hub checks a theme's css against them (ui/themes.theme_lint) so a model learns in its revision round that a rule matches nothing.

variables.--bg: the background of the desktop and of the pages
variables.--surface: panels, cards and the bars inside the pages
variables.--accent: the highlight colour (focused window, active entries, buttons)
variables.--track: the track of bars and meters
variables.--radius: the corner radius of the pages' controls
variables.--on-ok: text on a badge filled with --ok
variables.--on-warn: text on a badge filled with --warn
variables.--on-off: text on a grey badge (offline, not yet indexed)
variables.--app-chat: the colour of the chat application (its inbox tag, rule and task badge)
variables.--app-research: the colour of the research application
variables.--app-dev: the colour of the development application
variables.--app-admin: the colour of the administration application
variables.--app-project: the colour of the projects application
variables.--on-app: text on an application colour used as a fill (a task that may propose changes)
